label: For "Patient Safety Event Root-Cause Discovery": Find recurring contributing factors and system patterns across de-identified safety events, giving investigators hypotheses and evidence links without asserting causality from correlation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Reporting a correlation as a cause.
